sloka: स गत्वा तप आतिष्ठत् पार्श्वे तस्य उत्तरे गिरेः ।हिमवत् प्रभवे शृंगे सह देव्या महेश्वरः ॥१-३६-२५॥
transliteration: sa gatvā tapa ātiṣṭhat pārśve tasya uttare gireḥ ।himavat prabhave śṛṁge saha devyā maheśvaraḥ ॥1-36-25॥

translations.english: "The god of the gods (Mahesvara), seeing all the devatas humiliated began to depart in the westerly direction presided over by Varuna.
